title: STIBYS strike against Cervecería Hondureña
reason: The action is a labor dispute directed at the private employer over contract terms, outsourcing and job stability; no own-State demand is documented, and the opened sources describe a strike/plant shutdown rather than a qualifying public gathering.
notes: Government mediation was reported as a negotiation context, not the protest target. The private strike’s commencement and continuation are preserved separately from mass-mobilization events.
